1.note: Bright synth-pop with a big singalong chorus and handclaps. Feels like a sunny morning commute.

2.note: Dusty lofi beat with soft keys and vinyl crackle. Steady and unobtrusive, made for long late-night sessions at a desk.

3.note: Loud guitar rock with pounding drums and a fast tempo. Pure adrenaline from the first bar.

4.note: Gentle lofi piano layered over the sound of rain on a window. Very calm, almost sleepy.

5.note: Pumping pop anthem with a heavy kick drum and a shouted hook. Built for pushing through the last set.

6.note: Slow ambient pads with no drums at all. Floaty and spacious, like drifting in zero gravity.

7.note: Soft jazz trio with brushed drums, upright bass and warm piano. Sounds like a quiet cafe in the afternoon.

8.note: Moody synthwave with a driving bassline and neon 80s synths. Made for city lights after dark.

9.note: Minimal lofi loop with a soft guitar and no vocals. Keeps a steady pulse that helps you stay on task.

10.note: Jangly indie pop with shimmery guitars and a warm, hopeful vocal. Easy to like on the first listen.

11.note: Confident hip hop with a punchy beat and swaggering verses. Head-nod energy without being frantic.

12.note: Slow solo piano piece in a minor key. Quiet, sad and reflective.

13.note: Warm country tune with acoustic guitar and pedal steel about driving back to a childhood town.

14.note: Crushing heavy metal with down-tuned guitars and blast beats. Aggressive and very loud.

15.note: Smooth r&b slow jam with silky vocals and a laid-back groove.

16.note: Easygoing reggae with an offbeat guitar skank and a sunny, relaxed bounce.

17.note: Huge festival EDM track with a long build and a massive drop. Euphoric and nonstop.

18.note: Quiet folk song with fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a soft, sad voice.

19.note: Upbeat latin pop with bright horns and a reggaeton rhythm. Hard to sit still to.

20.note: Slow electric blues with a crying guitar and a smoky late-night feel.
